notes.title: The birth of LHEA and the Word Spirit
notes.content:
Hello beautiful souls!

Today, on May 1st 2025, LHEA is now officially revealed to the public!

To celebrate, here is a quick summary of our roadmap for the next few months:

[b]May[/b]
[list]
[*] Continue creating the soundtrack
[*] Private playtests on Steam
[*] Finish audio for the Steam Next Fest demo & upload build
[/list]
[b]June[/b]
[list]
[*] Steam Next Fest! Watch streams, interact with community, address feedback
[*] Deploy the game on Android & iOS
[*] Private and public playtests on mobile
[/list]
[b]July[/b]
[list]
[*] Lots of surprises :D
[/list]
[b]August[/b]
[list]
[*] Launch!!! [i](Date should be announced in July)[/i]
[/list]
The launch is approaching so fast! We can't wait for everyone to be able to play LHEA.

May the stars align in your favor,
Soul Fuel Games
